summary: Short steep kerb by overgrown bush verge; homes 20 m or more away.
reasons: Bush verge backs the northern end

best_section.where: Stanley Street west kerb, north of the junction, beside the overgrown verge

drivers.seclusion: Dense bush on the west verge; dwellings 21 m or more at the start, 12 m at the far end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with overgrown verge; cars park on the east side, so room to pull in is tight.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the east kerb; none seen on this side.

flags: Dwellings 12 m and 13 m from the kerb at the south end
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover over the kerb; houses to the south-west shade the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge leaves room to stop
